title: contact_received payload
description: Normalized confirmed-contact data. Raw PII and message text are forbidden.

contact_type.description: Stable technical contact type, e.g. contact_form, offer_request, callback_request, direct_email, whatsapp_message, qualified_call.

provider_reference.description: Stable non-secret provider message/call reference when available.

product_number.description: Related product/SKU when the contact is explicitly product-specific.
